tells: 1. Strip barely changes over a full second at laugh onset: only the white-sweater woman lifts a hand to her mouth, the other five front people hold the same pose and head angle, so the laugh does not build or spread (club-5-strip.png, all six frames, front tables)
2. Face close reads as a game asset: low-poly jaw and cheek silhouette, waxy skin, and the hand's fingers merge into the chin with no contact shadow (club-4-face.png, centre face and hand)
3. Depth-of-field compositing halos: the out-of-focus blonde and green-top figures have semi-transparent, ghosted edges with background bleeding through their bodies (club-4-face.png, left third)

4. Front row is lit flat and uniformly bright against a near-black room, so the people look pasted on rather than sitting in candlelight; candles light the tables but not the faces or hands (club-1-wide.png, centre front tables)

5. Back of house is a band of near-identical standing dark silhouettes in rigid upright poses, with a black blocking shape at the bottom centre and half the frame empty black ceiling (club-1-wide.png, upper half, rear rows and bottom centre)

1. Second and third rows look like they are standing or floating above the seats with stiff straight torsos and arms hanging down, so the stalls read as a stacked cast of figures, not seated people (theatre-1-wide.png, centre rows 2-3; theatre-6-held.png, left column)

2. The spill light makes a hard-edged bright rectangle of front-row people, with abrupt black on either side and a uniform silhouette wall behind; it looks like a spotlight on a cutout group (theatre-1-wide.png, whole frame)
3. Untextured or flat-grey limbs and cutout-like edges: the front-left woman's grey sleeve and arm, and the left-column faces read as flat cards (theatre-6-held.png, bottom-left and left column)
4. Close-up shows hair with blocky texture, an earring hoop with aliasing, a hand that clips into the collar, and DOF halos around the blurred people behind (theatre-4-face.png, centre and edges)

5. The same handful of assets (teal hoodie, purple top, teal-shirt blonde, brown jacket) is repeated side by side and shared with the other venues, so the crowd looks cloned (theatre-2-mid.png, front row; theatre-3-mid.png, front row)
1. Laughing mouths show dark, brace-like teeth and an inner mouth with no depth, so the laugh faces read as CG at TV distance (openmic-2-mid.png, centre blonde and brown-haired woman)
2. Hair alpha is dithered or stippled into a speckled fringe at the back and side of the head, and there is a halo where the DOF background meets the head (openmic-4-face.png, right side of the head)

3. Hands float and arms intersect: the brown-haired woman's hand hovers in front of her chest without touching, and the blonde's arm passes into her neighbour (openmic-6-held.png, centre right; openmic-5-strip.png, t=13.0)

4. The wide packs everyone into one evenly lit cluster with the same forward lean and hands on knees, and the far wall's door is a flat, self-lit rectangle, which breaks scale and integration (openmic-1-wide.png, centre crowd and left door)

5. The laugh starts in neighbouring pairs on the same beat (frames 12.6-12.8, three heads turn and open their mouths together), which feels triggered rather than caused (openmic-5-strip.png, bottom row centre)
